title: 第86章 悲催的包远

第86章 悲催的包远-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

他们家过年，基本上不用买年礼，回绿城的时候，还能将后备箱装的满满当当的。

大年初二，早上九点多，家里就又热闹了起来，吴姜的大姑吴时芳一家子到了。

吴姜跑得最快，几步就冲到门口，麻利地从大姑和大姑父包志勇手里接过沉甸甸的礼品，脸上笑得合不拢嘴。

他的小金库，马上又能多出几张红票子了。

“姑姑，姑父，新年好！”

和姑姑姑父问好之后，转头和表哥包远打了声招呼，又笑着揉了揉小表弟的脑袋。

小表弟今年刚满十岁，长得虎头虎脑，一双眼睛滴溜溜转，一看就是个精力旺盛的主。

大姑家有两个孩子，当初怀老二的时候，大姑和大姑父特意找医生看过，对方拍着胸脯信誓旦旦地保证，怀的肯定是个女儿，大姑父为此高兴得好几天合不拢嘴。

结果孩子生下来，又是个小子，听说当时大姑父脸上的表情，那是相当的精彩。

包远看着吴姜，笑着调侃道：“小姜，听姥爷说，你现在当道士了？你可是老吴家的独苗，可不能断了香火啊！”

吴姜翻了个大大的白眼，没好气地说道：“屁的道士，我就是跟一个老道士学过两手罢了，再说了，谁说道士就不能结婚生孩子了？”

顿了顿，他又坏笑着回怼了过去：“说到结婚，远哥，你猜今天吃饭的时候，会发生什么？”

这下，轮到包远翻白眼了，一脸生无可恋。

包远过完年就二十六了，已经出来工作好几年，工作也算顺利，可就是对结婚提不起兴趣，到现在连个对象都没有，可把大姑给愁坏了。

兄弟俩这边互怼，吴时安那边也没闲着，已经给大姑父包志勇点上了烟，正凑在一起吞云吐雾。

很快，就到了期待已久的环节了。

王雅琴率先拿出现金，给了包远和包沐辰一人五百块，大姑是个讲究人，吴姜的小金库立马多了一千块。

大姑拉着吴姜的手，笑着问道：“小姜，已经毕业了，找对象了没有？”

During the Chinese New Year, their family basically doesn’t need to buy New Year gifts, and when they return to Greentown, they can still fill the trunk full.

On the second day of the Lunar New Year, around nine o'clock in the morning, the house became lively again. Wu Jiang's aunt Wu Shifang and her family arrived.

Wu Jiang ran the fastest and rushed to the door in a few steps. He quickly took the heavy gift from his aunt and uncle Bao Zhiyong, smiling from ear to ear.

His little treasury will soon have a few more red notes.

"Aunt, uncle, happy New Year!"

After saying hello to my aunt and uncle, I turned around to say hello to my cousin Bao Yuan, and then smiled and rubbed my little cousin's head.

The little cousin has just turned ten this year. He has a tiger-like head and a pair of eyes. At first glance, he is an energetic person.

My aunt's family has two children. When she was pregnant with the second child, her aunt and uncle went to see a doctor. The doctor patted her chest and assured her that she was definitely pregnant with a daughter. My uncle was so happy that he couldn't open his mouth for several days.

When the child was born, he was a boy again. I heard that the expression on my uncle's face was quite wonderful.

Bao Yuan looked at Wu Jiang and joked with a smile: "Xiao Jiang, I heard grandpa say that you are a Taoist priest now? You are the only child of the old Wu family, so you can't let your incense die!"

Wu Jiang rolled his eyes and said angrily: "You damn Taoist priest, I just learned a few tricks from an old Taoist priest. Besides, who can't get married and have children as a Taoist priest?"

After a pause, he replied with a wicked smile: "Speaking of marriage, Brother Yuan, guess what will happen during dinner today?"

Now, it was Bao Yuan's turn to roll his eyes, with a look of despair on his face.

Bao Yuan will be twenty-six after the Chinese New Year. He has been working for several years and his work is going well, but he just has no interest in getting married. He doesn't even have a partner yet, which makes his aunt very worried.

The two brothers were arguing with each other, and Wu Shi'an was not idle either. He had already lit a cigarette for his eldest uncle Bao Zhiyong, and they were puffing away together.

Soon, the long-awaited part came.

Wang Yaqin was the first to take out the cash and gave Bao Yuan and Bao Muchen five hundred yuan each. The aunt was a very particular person, and Wu Jiang's small coffers immediately gained a thousand yuan.

The aunt took Wu Jiang's hand and asked with a smile: "Xiao Jiang, you have graduated. Have you found a partner?"
